sections.title: Teach, Discover, Connect: biology and community (A)
sections.description: Step outside of Penn's classroom into West Philadelphia High School to teach biology to local high school students. At Penn, students will learn inclusive and evidence-based approaches to science pedagogy through readings and discussion. At West Philadelphia High school, Penn students will act as facilitators of learning, presenting hands-on activities to the students and guiding them in their conceptual understanding of topics in the high school biology curriculum. To deepen their understanding of these foundational topics. Penn students will trace the scientific development of a topic of their choosing from the high school curriculum. They will identify seminal studies that have contributed significantly to our current understanding and synthesize these findings into a timeline illustrating how scientific knowledge has evolved over time. Through this combination of pedagogy, community engagement, and scientific inquiry, students will gain experience both in teaching biology and in understanding how biological knowledge is constructed. This is an Academically Based Community Service (ABCS) course supported by the Netter Center for Community Partnerships.
